query: Help me understand the key points in this table — what should I concentrate on?

per_column.name: Rating_Category
per_column.rationale: Buckets the overall evaluation into 'Very Positive/Positive/Mixed/Negative'. This is a summary label of the WHOLE quality judgment, not an aspect OF it — it restates the concept rather than carving out a constitutive part.

per_column.name: Key_Issues
per_column.rationale: Enumerates the specific dimensions along which service is judged (Seating, Food, Service, Entertainment, Pricing, Delay, Baggage). These are genuine part-of aspects of service quality. However it is a single compound multi-label field packing many facets into one column rather than one facet per column, which undermines clean MECE decomposition.

per_column.name: Sentiment_Gap
per_column.rationale: A derived numeric difference metric (e.g., gap between sub-ratings and overall/expectation). A computed gap is an analytic artifact about the quality signal, not a constitutive aspect that the concept is composed of.

per_column.name: Route_Type
per_column.rationale: Short/Medium/Long-haul is a contextual attribute of the flight that may correlate with or drive perceived service quality, but route length is not an aspect OF service quality itself — it is an external segmentation variable.

judge.rationale: Only one of four columns (Key_Issues) is a true meronymic facet of airline_service_quality; the rest are a whole-concept restatement (Rating_Category), a derived metric (Sentiment_Gap), and an external contextual predictor (Route_Type). Mutual exclusivity is low: the sole facet column is a compound multi-label field bundling many distinct aspects together, and Rating_Category and Sentiment_Gap both re-express the overall sentiment signal, so the added columns do not cleanly partition the concept into non-overlapping aspects. Exhaustiveness is moderate-to-low: although Key_Issues internally touches many constitutive dimensions (seating, food, service, entertainment, pricing, punctuality, baggage), the augmentation does not provide separate facet columns covering the concept's main aspects, so as a faceted decomposition it is largely unrealised.
